description: This file defines a UI component named 'CartView' using LightningJS framework. It renders the shopping cart interface, displaying cart items, subtotal, and checkout options. It also manages its state with subscriptions to a centralized store 'AppStore'.

classes.name: CartView
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the shopping cart view, including item list, subtotal, and checkout button.

methods.name: incQty
methods.description: Increases the quantity of a cart item by 1.

methods.name: decQty
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a cart item by 1, with a minimum of 1.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Initiates the checkout process if the cart is not empty.
